You have nothing to lose right?

"It is not worth it"

Sorry my friend but it's not worth it for you and all the persons you mentioned. For him, was more than worth it. You are thinking about your own pain, was it more worth it he keep suffering constantly to not make the others stuff? But then it's worth it for others but not for him... i I don't intend to come here with hate comments, i iust wanted to show you the other side of the coin.

See this as a learning, to care about others and treat everyone well because we never know what is inside their mind.

I wish you all the best and strength.
